name: Codex Sidebar Sorter
summary: Sort supported Codex projects and chats by name, natural number, update time, or manual order. The desktop preview runs on Windows x64 and tested Ubuntu Linux x64, with English as the default and twelve selectable languages.
description:
## Organize Codex projects and chats

Sort supported Codex projects and chats by name, natural number, update time, or manual order. The desktop preview runs on Windows x64 and tested Ubuntu Linux x64, with English as the default and twelve selectable languages. Close the companion window to keep its tray worker active.

## Install

Choose [Windows x64](https://github.com/syj3426962511-glitch/codex-sidebar-sorter/releases/download/v1.4.3-preview/CodexSidebarSorter-1.4.3-Windows-Setup.exe) or [Ubuntu Linux x64](https://github.com/syj3426962511-glitch/codex-sidebar-sorter/releases/download/v1.4.3-preview/CodexSidebarSorter-1.4.3-Linux-x64-Setup.run). Start a compatible, signed-in Codex Desktop client and select **Refresh** in the companion. See the [release page](https://github.com/syj3426962511-glitch/codex-sidebar-sorter/releases/tag/v1.4.3-preview) for the Mac installation previews and exact test results.

## What the purchase includes

USD 9.50 one-time for the English agent skill. The skill explains installation, the seven sorting modes, background operation, and troubleshooting. The desktop installers are available on GitHub.
demo_request: Sort the chats in Research Plan by natural number so Task 2 appears before Task 10 and Task 20. Keep name ordering enabled for everyday use.
demo_result:
1. Start a compatible signed-in Codex Desktop client and open Codex Sidebar Sorter. Select **Refresh**.
2. Select **Research Plan** under **Scope**. These examples use fictional chat names.
3. Choose **Natural numeric order** for chats. Read the preview in this order: **Task 2**, **Task 10**, **Task 20**.
4. Select **Apply to sidebar** and verify the order in Codex. If the list changed since the preview, refresh and check the scope before applying again.
5. Turn on **Keep names sorted A to Z** to resume continuous alphabetical ordering. Close the companion window to leave the tray worker running.

faq.question: What will I receive after purchase?
faq.answer: An English agent skill with installation, sorting, background usage and troubleshooting steps. Desktop installers are available through GitHub Releases.

faq.question: Which systems can I use?
faq.answer: Use the Windows x64 or tested Ubuntu Linux x64 desktop preview with a compatible client. Both Mac architectures have installation previews with authenticated sidebar ordering pending.

faq.question: Can I change the language?
faq.answer: English is the default. Twelve languages are available, including Simplified and Traditional Chinese, as well as Arabic right-to-left layout.

faq.question: Can it work after its window closes?
faq.answer: The tray and worker stay active. Use the tray to reopen the window or stop the worker.

compatibility: Windows x64 and Ubuntu Linux x64 with a compatible, signed-in Codex Desktop on the same machine. The 1.4.3 Windows lifecycle check used Codex 26.1111.9265.0. The signed-in Linux ordering test used companion 1.4.2 on Ubuntu 26.04.1 x64 with Codex 26.1111.21308.
known_limitations: Intel Mac and Apple Silicon packages are installation previews. Signed-in 1.4.3 ordering, replacement between distinct Codex client builds, and notarized Mac distribution remain open.
requirements: Windows x64 or compatible Ubuntu Linux x64
Compatible Codex Desktop signed in on the same computer
requirement_note: Install Codex Sidebar Sorter 1.4.3 on Windows x64 or compatible Ubuntu Linux x64, then open a compatible signed-in Codex Desktop on the same machine. The companion includes its runtime.
